title: Meta President Dina Powell McCormick says building new US data centers will be harder after midterm results, but it will be easier to expand existing projects (Meghan Bobrowsky/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Meghan Bobrowsky / Wall Street Journal: Meta President Dina Powell McCormick says building new US data centers will be harder after midterm results, but it will be easier to expand existing projects — Speaking at the WSJ Tech conference, Dina Powell McCormick says the company is more optimistic about scaling up its existing data centers
